English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us Society A video released several years ago during the Israeli-Palestinian crisis is circulating again. Misleading As the Israeli-Palestinian conflict continues to escalate, various news, photos, and videos of violence are being shared on social media. by Anonymous | November 13, 2023 As the Israeli-Palestinian conflict continues to escalate, various news, photos, and videos of violence are being shared on social media. Factseeker has observed that a video of Hamas militants, allegedly released recently, is currently circulating on Facebook and Twitter. “Thank you, Iran, for giving us weapons, money, and other equipment. They supplied us with missiles to destroy Zionist strongholds and helped with various operations. It looks like Joe Biden’s $6 billion to Iran was well spent.” Factseeker investigated the authenticity of the video, which allegedly contains a Hamas statement. This video has been circulating on social media for several years. Factseeker was able to observe that the same video was shared on social media, especially in 2017 and 2018, after Google reversed this video. As the Israeli-Palestinian conflict continues to escalate, various news, photos, and videos of violence are being shared on social media. Factseeker has observed that a video of Hamas militants, allegedly released recently, is currently circulating on Facebook and Twitter. “Thank you, Iran, for giving us weapons, money, and other equipment. They supplied us with missiles to destroy Zionist strongholds and helped with various operations. It looks like Joe Biden’s $6 billion to Iran was well spent.” Factseeker investigated the authenticity of the video, which allegedly contains a Hamas statement. This video has been circulating on social media for several years. Factseeker was able to observe that the same video was shared on social media, especially in 2017 and 2018, after Google reversed this video. Here is the video that was shared on YouTube in 2018. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c40mv5lbPiE Accordingly, Factseeker confirms that the video, which has been circulating on social media, is a video from a few years ago. We are an independent fact-checking team affiliated with the Sri Lanka Press Institute(SLPI). The objective and long-term goal of the FactSeeker is to provide the public with reliable and verified content in the attempt of debunking mis/disinformation. The unit, with the SLPI, is committed to contributing to improved media literacy in Sri Lanka.
